title: Neighborhood-Aware Unlearning for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative recommendation predicts items by autoregressively generating semantic identifiers (SIDs), whose tokens are shared across semantically related items. With this paradigm gaining adoption, the question of how to support unlearning in it has become pressing. If training interactions must later be removed, such as injected spam or interactions with items a user no longer wants, this sharing lets an unlearning update unintentionally affect the predictions for the interactions' neighbors. We show that this effect is locally structured and hidden by global metrics: unlearning can leave recommendation utility on the whole test set nearly unchanged while substantially degrading it on neighborhoods of the forgotten interactions' SIDs. We propose Neighborhood-Aware Unlearning (NAU), which augments interaction-level unlearning with explicit control over the probability mass assigned to the forgotten items' neighborhoods. translated_title: 面向生成式推荐的邻域感知遗忘
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐通过自回归方式生成语义标识符（SID）来预测物品，而这些标识符的词元在语义相关的物品之间是共享的。随着这一范式逐渐被采用，如何在其框架下支持机器遗忘已成为一个紧迫的问题。当训练数据中的交互需要被移除时——例如注入的垃圾信息，或用户不再想要的物品的交互——这种共享机制会使遗忘更新在无意中影响到与被遗忘交互相邻的物品的预测结果。我们证明这种影响具有局部结构性，并且会被全局指标所掩盖：遗忘操作可能使整个测试集上的推荐效用几乎保持不变，同时却在被遗忘交互的SID所在邻域上造成显著的性能退化。我们提出了邻域感知遗忘（Neighborhood-Aware Unlearning, NAU），它在交互级别的遗忘基础上，增加了对分配给被遗忘物品邻域的概率质量的显式控制。在三个数据集上的实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了生成式推荐中的机器遗忘会因语义标识符的共享而无意识地损害被遗忘物品邻域内的推荐性能，且该退化被全局指标掩盖，并提出邻域感知遗忘（NAU）方法，在交互级遗忘的同时对被遗忘物品邻域的概率质量进行显式控制。
